vcs.class_ratio_training: 1:1 (P and Q means separate; K = 8 pool negatives per anchor)

js.class_ratio_training: 1:1 (P and Q means separate; K = 8 pool negatives per anchor)

logistic.posterior: q = sigma(f) of the in-batch pairwise logistic
logistic.class_ratio_training: 1 : (B - 1) = 1 : 255 in-batch pairs, mean over the B x B matrix
logistic.note: the correction is rank-preserving and is NOT applied to any training or score record here

infonce.class_ratio_training: row / column softmax over B in-batch candidates
infonce.note: no pairwise posterior; p_ii is a row-softmax probability, reported in its own column

retraining_disclosure: P72 adapters were never saved; every model here is retrained through robust_r2r3.train_r with P72's selected (lr, epochs), seed 0, the same topic partners and injection (sha256 checked)
